method: Exact original project bytes through previewUrl; official UI Start; only webpack loader reference exposed. Read-only runtime-manager and stage snapshots. No registry/domain/timer/random overrides.
limitations: Wall-clock delays are not fixed frame counts; snapshots are not aligned to the benchmark.
No original file changes; no claim about unobserved gameplay, pixels, audio waveform, task equality or full-run correctness.
Only input-kn receives one synthetic a press/release after passive snapshots; all other projects receive no synthesized gameplay input.
Fresh unauthenticated headless desktop Edge; no physical devices or native host.
Long lists retain only length/head/tail; not full list equality.
Console/resource errors (including unauthenticated HTTP 401/403 and one 422) are retained; no-uncaught-page-errors does not mean a clean network/service session.
archiveCompaction: Runtime strings >128 UTF-16 code units become kind/length/UTF-8 SHA256/head<=40 summaries. Small typed fixture values are otherwise complete. Definitions retained once per case; duplicate monitor copies omitted except actor scope contrasts; page UI tails omitted. Full original observations remain in rawReports under dist.

sourceFacts.fact: Runtime manager elapsed timer reads wall-clock Date difference in seconds, not elapsed frame count.
